'''Kabalard Vinne''' was a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] outlaw during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A former representative of the [[Guild of Armament Distributors]], Vinne was responsible for an [[Raid on the Wroona Stardock|attack]] on the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Rampant]]'', which was undergoing repairs at [[Wroona Stardock]].
